hiring.positions_note: 3 current academic/Faculty of Medicine-related posts found today: “Docente Obstetricia Sede Santiago”, “Tutor(a) Docente, Asignatura Medicina Familiar y Comunitaria”, and “Coordinador(a) Académico(a) Medicina-Santiago”. The last is an academic-administration role, not a teaching appointment. No rheumatology post was found.
hiring.requires_chilean_title_note: The published requirements reviewed do not mention Chilean nationality, revalidación, recognition of a foreign degree, or EUNACOM. The Medicina coordinator advert says: “Profesional del área de la salud”; it does not state how a foreign medical title is assessed. This is not evidence that clinical practice is permitted without Chilean recognition.

international.notes: The Vicerrectoría de Asuntos Internacionales operates exchange, intensive and virtual-mobility programmes. Medicine requires certification of English proficiency for the licenciatura, but the official programme page does not say that a medical subject is taught in English. A 2026 scheme funds invited international doctoral visiting professors.

profile_paragraphs: UNAB’s Faculty of Medicine comprises the Schools of Medicine, Pharmacy, Medical Technology, Nutrition and Obstetrics, plus Morphology, postgraduate, biomedical and public-health units. Its School of Medicine was created in 2000.
Medicine is offered in Santiago, Viña del Mar and Concepción. The official faculty page lists a seven-year programme leading to Licenciado en Medicina and Médico Cirujano.
The Medicine programme is accredited by Chile’s CNA for five years, from 20 January 2022 to 20 January 2027, at its three listed locations.

UNAB reports clinical-training agreements with public and private institutions. Its published network names hospitals in Santiago, Valparaíso and Biobío, including El Pino, Gustavo Fricke, Carlos Van Buren, Tomé and Penco-Lirquén.

For a foreign rheumatologist, a current Medicine tutor vacancy may be relevant to teaching. However, no official UNAB page located in this search identifies a rheumatology unit or a rheumatology specialist-training programme, and the current vacancy requirements do not address foreign-title recognition.

sources.what_it_supports: Official faculty name, composition, dean and dean email.
Official history of the School of Medicine.
Medicine degree, duration, locations, accreditation, school contacts and English-certification requirement.
Faculty management-contact emails in the three locations.
Campus República address and Faculty of Medicine location.
Official clinical-training network and named hospitals/clinics.
Faculty postgraduate and specialist-training context; no specific rheumatology programme is listed on the page.
Live official listing containing the current Obstetrics and Family/Community Medicine teaching posts.
Current Faculty of Medicine academic-coordinator role and its published requirements.
International office identity, mobility programmes and international-student services.

unknowns: No current UNAB-owned page found that identifies a dedicated rheumatology unit, service or department at UNAB or clearly ties one to its clinical-training network.
No current UNAB-owned page found for a rheumatology specialty programme/beca; this is recorded as unknown rather than inferred absent.

The faculty contact page publishes emails but no faculty-specific telephone or single faculty street address. The phone is the number displayed in the Faculty site header; the address is the listed Campus República Faculty location.
No official source found confirming that any Medicine subject is delivered in English; English proficiency/courses are not evidence of English-medium medical instruction.

The live portal does not publish a rule on revalidación or foreign medical qualifications in the current Faculty of Medicine-related adverts. Clinical work in Chile should therefore be checked separately with the relevant professional and immigration authorities.
